identification: Three sealed horror soundtrack LPs: Child's Play (Joe Renzetti, Waxwork, 2019, hype sticker), Halloween 2018 OST (Sacred Bones SBR-213), Halloween II (Death Waltz/Mondo, orange obi). Colour variants not visible through shrink.

entries.note: Page opened. Halloween II Mondo orange/red/blue stripe, mint. Page says accepted best offer, final price questionable. Rate USD1=AUD1.53 assumed. Only one sold price, US, 4 years old.
Page opened. Child's Play Waxwork 2xLP coloured, listed SOLD OUT. Retail new price at issue, not a resale. Lot's copy looks like a single sleeve; may be 2LP gatefold.
Snippet only, not verified. Halloween 2018 SBR-213 black LP retail about USD20-30 (AUD30-45). Common, in print repeatedly.

entries.price: USD 47.99 (2025 Mondo reissue); EUR 60 (2012 Death Waltz orange, last copy)
entries.note: Snippet only, not verified. Reissue is in print so caps resale of the Halloween II LP; orange obi with Mondo/Death Waltz logo suggests the 2014-2018 era pressing.
